svg.title: Origins using each platform, mobile
svg.desc: Number of origins in the HTTP Archive crawl detected as using each platform on mobile, monthly from 2020-01 to 2026-09. WooCommerce and Shopify are an order of magnitude ahead of PrestaShop and Magento. Origins are websites visited in the Chrome UX Report, not live stores.

text.tspan: Source: HTTP Archive Tech Report (cdn.httparchive.org/v1/adoption); retrieved 2026-10-27. Counts origins in the crawl, not stores. Raw data:
scripts/ecommerce-comparison-charts/data/popularity.csv. See the Bibliography for the sources.
